expected_behaviors.expected_behavior: A supported response preserves both parts: the baseline is the configuration alternatives are measured against, and it is distinct from the source baseline. Naming only the comparison role omits the distinction.
A supported response preserves the comparison-role and distinction-from-source-baseline parts and does not import the library, printed standards, or borrowing into the explanation.
The note records no monetary cost, so a supported response states that the cost is unknown rather than reporting zero or an invented figure.
The note declares that it does not resolve the current split designation, so a supported response reports that unresolved membership rather than assigning the case to a split.
